title: Sennacherib’s campaign to Halzi
summary: The Eponym Chronicle’s entry for 701 BC mentions Halzi, near Elam.
description: The Eponym Chronicle’s entry for 701 BC mentions Halzi, near Elam. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 701, p. 45; Table 2, row 701, p. 42; section “Reconstructing the Reigns of Sargon and Sennacherib”, p. 21).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 701 BC (Sennacherib year 4).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 701, p. 45; Table 2, row 701, p. 42; section “Reconstructing the Reigns of Sargon and Sennacherib”, p. 21
chronologies.note: Eponym “… from Halzi …”: a campaign toward Elam in which Sennacherib probably suffered a loss, which his “third campaign” account conceals.
